scientific_integrity: Based on an independently proved combinatorial orbit enumeration and a cited previously established algebraic structure theorem. The source preprint is cited as prior work. Computations confirm only finite examples.
scientific_limitations: The minimal-generator reduction applies for n>=5; no asymptotic estimate or small-degree formula is asserted. Equivalent orbit formulas may exist under other vocabulary. Independent validation not performed.
title: Plane partitions and exact generator ranks for endomorphism monoids of full transformation semigroups
